[ATangk] Go here after scoring personalised IKEA bags and $5 lunches at Rhodes.
[tahayp] is STUDENT working for anyone? it says 100% off but right before I enter the card details it still shows as paid
[romaau] Hi Everyone,
Not in Sydney, but would have loved to have gone.
Have been doing some research on Electric cars.
There are over 100 different models for sale and I am the kind of person that creates a spreadsheet with over 50 parameters and 250 rows (not all are filled in).
I was going to use AI to fill it in, but it hasn't been accurate so have been doing it manually.
Personally have some unique requirements like
* a short driveway meaning the length had to be less than 4.5m
* Boot space is important so have been measuring depth and width
* Also will have a car seat so have been looking at how far the rear doors open
Interesting insights:
* Cars are really wide now. Smallest width 5 seater was the Dolphin and it is still wider than a 04-08 Mazda 3.
* Lots of cars now have a 2nd storage space under the boot where the spare wheel used to be
* GWM Ora and Hyundai Kona only ones to have space saver, Cherry E5 only one with full size spare tire
Haven't settled on one just yet.
Hopefully someone find it useful.
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Bmzmy-7UnyH502_TYy6o…
